question: Which of the United Nation's organization has International Institute of Educational Planning at Paris as its part?
solution:
The correct answer is __**UNESCO.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **UNESCO** has the International Institute of Educational **Planning in Paris as its Part.**
 
• UNESCO's International Institute for Educational Planning was founded in **Paris, France, in 1963.**
 
• UNESCO:** United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization. **
 
• The United Nations Educational, Scientific, and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) was established** on 16 November 1945**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f034e2eac513da0b30c3543b6419622b8053b3817219fd77ae7c6c0df9a22430.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UNICEF** is committed to make sure **special defence for the most underprivileged children.**
 
• The International Labor Organization **(ILO)** is committed to encouraging** social justice and internationally recognized human and labour rights.**​ 
 
• The United Nations (UNO) defends** human rights, delivers humanitarian support, encourage sustainable development and upholds international law**.
